title: CalibrationCaptureLimits
description: Logical model/input/cache bounds, NOT tape/parser/package/evidence/full RSS.

max_config_bytes.description: Actual config input-byte cap before model parsing.

max_dense_bytes.description: Retained widened-f32 master matrix/vector cap before decoding.

max_text_bytes.description: Aggregate raw UTF-8 text bytes; zero for pretokenized capture.

max_tokenizer_config_bytes.description: tokenizer_config.json bytes; zero for pretokenized capture.

max_total_payload_bytes.description: Aggregate retained payload, including duplicated context bytes.

max_window_tokens.description: Effective maximum input tokens per context (excluding final label).

CalibrationCacheLimits.description: Logical retained cache bounds, separate from reducer workspace or process RSS.

max_payload_bytes.description: Exact retained scalar/token/mask and recipe bytes; excludes metadata/capacity overhead.

max_samples.description: Maximum observed samples, including masked samples.

max_windows.description: Maximum declared model-context windows, not reduction replay chunks.
